## What and why

Describe the problem, the change, and any related issue.

## Compatibility and scope

List affected packages/frameworks and any breaking changes or migration steps.
Explain why the change belongs in the current scope.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Include a focused regression case for
behavior changes and screenshots for visual changes. Explain anything not verified.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed the contribution guide and code of conduct.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I added appropriate regression coverage, or explained why none is needed.
- [ ] I added a Changeset for published behavior/API changes, or explained why it is unnecessary.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private application code, or personal information.
- [ ] This PR does not publicly disclose an uncoordinated vulnerability.
